title: Manager, EMEA Community (Contract)
description: Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com . This contract engagement is open to candidates based in the UK as a fixed-term leave cover. We are seeking a strategic community management professional to join our International Community Team, and lead a growing team in EMEA. As the Manager of Community for EMEA, you will spearhead the development and execution of the community strategy that supports Reddit’s growth in the region. In this role, you will lead a team of Community Specialists and will take charge of defining the roadmap for community activation and moderation across focus markets, and help develop our international playbook. Your work will focus on experimenting, iterating, and refining processes that drive community engagement at scale. The insights you generate through these efforts will accelerate Reddit’s growth in EMEA, and serve as a model for other emerging markets. This role reports to the Director, International Community. Responsibilities : Craft and champion the regional community strategy, ensuring alignment with overall team and business goals. Drive the iteration, innovation, and scaling of the community and moderator growth playbook, proactively identifying new opportunities and launching bold initiatives in key markets. Inspire and empower regional teams to execute impactful programs that elevate local communities, and their markets. Encourage innovation and create an environment of continuous learning and improvement. Recruit, onboard, and train local community specialists in key markets to strengthen our collaboration with moderators and drive community engagement. Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Growth, Product, Engineering, etc.) to ensure successful alignment and execution of new initiatives. Gather regional insights and learnings, and effectively report results to various internal stakeholders. Lead, coach and develop the regional team; translate strategy into quarterly and sprint priorities, clear ownership and milestones; review risks and capacity, and unblock delivery Own community-health and growth outcomes across priority markets, including KPI progression, moderator coverage and retention, and the impact of community-building initiatives. Coordinate with Content, Growth, Product and relevant safety partners to deliver market initiatives and surface local needs for broader roadmap decisions. Required qualifications: 5-7 years of experience in community management or marketing operations, including at least 1-2 years in a leadership role, with a proven track record of driving community growth and delivering business impact through community-led or marketing projects. Organized with a strong ability to balance strategic thinking with operational execution. Problem-solver with excellent interpersonal skills, capable of collaborating with diverse cross-functional teams and influencing them to adopt a community-first mindset. Comfortable testing, iterating, and adjusting strategies to find the optimal approach for each market. Skilled at navigating ambiguous environments and experimenting with different approaches to achieve results in focus markets. Data-driven and results-oriented, with a keen ability to translate insights into action. Deep understanding of Reddit’s unique identity, and the critical role communities and moderators play in adding value to the platform and enhancing user experiences. Bonus Points Experience in moderation on Reddit or similar platforms (e.g., Discord, Facebook, or other forums). In select roles and locations, the interviews will be recorded, transcribed and summarized by artificial intelligence (AI). You will have the opportunity to opt out of recording, transcription and summarization prior to any scheduled interviews. During the interview, we will collect the following categories of personal information: Identifiers, Professional and Employment-Related Information, Sensory Information (audio/video recording), and any other categories of personal information you choose to share with us. We will use this information to evaluate your application for employment or an independent contractor role, as applicable. We will not sell your personal information or disclose it to any third party for their marketing purposes. We will delete any recording of your interview promptly after making a hiring decision. For more information about how we will handle your personal information, including our retention of it, please refer to our Candidate Privacy Policy for Potential Employees and Contractors . Reddit is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and is committed to building a workforce representative of the diverse communities we serve. Reddit is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If, due to a disability, you need an accommodation during the interview process, please let your recruiter know.

title: Sr. Clinical Research Associate (Romania)
description: Alimentiv is a global CRO with a singular focus: advancing therapies for patients with gastrointestinal diseases. GI is our WHY and for more than 30 years that purpose has driven our scientific rigour, operational excellence, and deep therapeutic expertise, including supporting more than 70% of IBD compounds in development. We operate as a private, profit-with-purpose company, channeling our commercial success back into scientific research, technology, and our people. With approximately 700 people across multiple countries and three service lines, we are growing deliberately, and the capability of our leaders and our organization is central to how we get there. If you want to do meaningful work, build something real, and invest back in research that changes lives — we want to meet you! Job Overview The Senior Clinical Research Associate (Sr. CRA) independently performs, coordinates and oversees clinical site monitoring activities, ensuring compliance with study protocols, Alimentiv and sponsor procedures, ICH-GCP guidelines and local regulatory requirements. Serving as a primary liaison between investigative sites, Alimentiv and sponsors, the Sr. CRA plays a key role in the successful execution of clinical studies from site selection and start-up through monitoring and close-out. This role also provides guidance and mentorship to CRA I and CRA II colleagues and may participate in CRA assessment visits, co-monitoring activities, audits and inspections. Key Responsibilities Independently conduct and document onsite and remote site management activities, including site qualification, initiation, monitoring and close-out visits, in accordance with applicable SOPs and study requirements. Serve as a primary point of contact for investigative sites, building effective working relationships and ensuring site questions, issues, action items and protocol deviations are followed through to resolution. Review source documentation and study systems to ensure clinical data is accurate, complete and compliant with protocol, regulatory and study requirements; manage and facilitate the resolution of data queries. Oversee site activation and ongoing site management activities, working with sites and cross-functional teams to achieve project timelines, milestones and recruitment objectives. Ensure site personnel are appropriately trained on study protocols, plans, systems, ICH-GCP requirements and project-specific expectations. Routinely review Investigator Site Files (ISF), Trial Master Files (TMF) and study systems for accuracy, completeness, timeliness and compliance, requesting outstanding documentation as required. Coordinate site-related study activities and communications, including clinical supplies, investigational product, laboratory materials, ePROs, study documentation and ongoing project updates. Collaborate with Study Start-up, Regulatory and other cross-functional teams, including supporting document collection, localisation and translation activities where required. Participate in study meetings, Investigator Meetings, audits and inspections, supporting issue resolution and implementation of corrective actions when required. Mentor and support CRA I and CRA II colleagues, including CRA Assessment Visits, co-monitoring and sign-off activities; contribute to CRA interviews, training and process improvement initiatives as requested. Skills & Qualifications (Honours) Bachelor’s degree required; a degree in Health Sciences, Life Sciences, Pharmacy or Nursing is preferred. A Master’s degree is considered an asset. Minimum 4–6 years of relevant clinical research experience; 7–9 years of related experience is preferred. Experience across Phase I–IV clinical trials is preferred. Thorough knowledge of ICH-GCP and applicable local regulatory requirements. Demonstrated experience independently conducting site qualification, initiation, monitoring and close-out visits. Proficiency with clinical trial systems including EDC platforms (e.g., Medidata Rave, Oracle InForm), IRT, eTMF and CTMS, as well as Microsoft Office. Strong interpersonal, communication and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently and effectively within cross-functional teams. Strong organisational skills, attention to detail and the ability to manage priorities with an appropriate sense of urgency. Fluent written and verbal English; an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience may be considered. Valid driver’s licence and ability to travel approximately 40–60%, depending on project assignment and the geographic location of investigative sites. What We Offer In addition, as an Alimentiv Employee, you’re also eligible for the following programs: Education Reimbursement program for full-time employees Monthly Cell Phone and Remote Work Allowance (dependent on role eligibility) One time office setup allowance (can be used to purchase a scanner/printer, extra monitor, office furniture, etc.) Working while visiting program – up to 4 weeks per year! Flexible Summer Hours Program from May – September Employee referral incentive – we know great people know other great people, and we think that warrants recognition! Full-time employees also become beneficiaries of the Alimentiv Trust after one year of employment, and permanent members after 5 years of employment Optional formal mentorship program (Alimentorship); country/region annual social events in person; leadership development programs for people leaders in accordance with your seniority; social committee and several other optional initiatives designed to support you in feeling like part of the Alimentiv team! Additional benefits may be available depending on the country of employment and are subject to local policies and eligibility. Our Services End-to-end GI clinical trial services, from protocol design through submission support Central medical imaging management and endoscopic reading Precision medicine and biomarker solutions Real-world evidence and clinical consulting Histopathology and lab services through AcelaBio How to Apply To apply for this position, please submit your resume through the Alimentiv Careers Portal or via LinkedIn’s Easy Apply. Resumes must be submitted in English. Equal Opportunity and Accessibility Alimentiv is committed to building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. We are an equal opportunity employer and consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, ethnicity, national origin, religion or belief, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital or family status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Accommodations are available upon request for persons with disabilities throughout the recruitment and selection process. Requests can be directed to recruitment@alimentiv.com . Compensation Additionally: Annual Bonus (Short Term Incentive Program) target = 8% of annual salary A monthly stipend of 400 RON (pro-rated based on hours of work), to be paid with their regular payroll/added to their taxable income. This is intended to offset the business use of the employee’s communication costs (internet, VoIP, land line, etc.) Monthly Cell phone stipend (RON 50) A one time expense reimbursement of up to 500.00 (local currency) to purchase other office items such as a scanner/printer, an extra monitor, office furniture and supplies, etc. Mileage reimbursement for travel Additional Information Stay Alert to Recruitment Scams Alimentiv is aware of a continued increase in phishing scams, which use various methods of attack via email, text, voice and social media, including individuals posing as our recruiters and contacting candidates with fraudulent opportunities. Our hiring process always includes direct engagement with a recruiter or hiring manager, and we will never ask for sensitive personal information early in the process. Official communication will only come from company email addresses containing "@alimentiv.com". If you are contacted about an open job at Alimentiv, please verify the domain of the sender's email address and confirm that you are being asked to apply on this website. If something doesn't feel right, we encourage you to verify before responding. If you believe you have been the victim of a phishing scam, please contact your local government cyber authority to report it.

title: Staff Product Designer - Platform Design
description: The Platform team creates the technology that enables Spotify to learn quickly and scale easily, enabling rapid growth in our users and our business around the globe. Spanning many disciplines, we work to make the business work; creating the infrastructure, tooling, frameworks, and capabilities needed to welcome a billion customers. Spotify runs on the tools we've built for ourselves. They help hundreds of teams ship every day to hundreds of millions of people around the world. Now, we're sharing them. Spotify Technology brings our proven tools and services together for engineering organisations everywhere, from global enterprises to individual developers. As AI reshapes how software gets made, we're building on years of experience solving complex engineering challenges at scale. Platform Design makes these powerful tools feel effortless. We shape the services, products and experiences used by Spotify's engineering teams and by developers around the world. We believe great design is a competitive advantage, and developer tools deserve the same care and craft as any consumer product. As a Staff Product Designer, you'll combine product leadership with hands-on design and engineering. You'll shape the experience strategy for a key part of the Spotify Technology portfolio, establish a distinctive visual language, and turn internal tools into products customers love using. You'll work closely with product, engineering and marketing partners, reporting to the Spotify Technology Design Director. What You'll Do Lead complex design challenges from early exploration through to production, creating intuitive flows, interfaces, interactions and motion that make powerful developer tools easier to use. Shape the visual language of Spotify Technology, bringing consistency, personality and craft across product experiences and brand touchpoints. Transform tools built for Spotify's engineering teams into compelling commercial products that meet the needs of developers and enterprise customers. Bring design to life in code, building and shipping high-quality front-end experiences with close attention to performance, accessibility and detail. Set experience strategy across your product area, partnering with product and engineering leaders to influence priorities, guide decisions and shape the roadmap. Use prototypes, storytelling and experimentation to make complex ideas tangible, build alignment and help teams navigate trade-offs. Explore how generative AI and agentic tools can improve design and development workflows, while creating thoughtful experiences for products used by people and AI agents. Raise the bar for design craft across the team, championing design systems, inclusive experiences and a culture of collaboration, feedback and continuous learning. Who You Are You have a strong background in product design, with experience shaping complex digital products and delivering high-quality visual and interaction design. You're comfortable working across strategy and execution, setting a clear product direction while staying close to the details of design and delivery. You can build and ship user interfaces using a modern front-end technology stack, and enjoy bringing your designs into production. You understand how to create cohesive visual experiences across product and brand, with a thoughtful approach to interaction, motion and design systems. You bring an understanding of developer tools, enterprise software or platform products, including the challenges of designing for technical audiences. You use generative AI and agentic tools in your work, applying sound judgement about where they add value and where human expertise matters most. You're comfortable navigating ambiguity, using research, data and customer insights to make informed decisions and solve complex problems. You communicate ideas clearly, build trust across disciplines and influence product decisions through compelling design work and storytelling. You care about helping others grow, welcome different perspectives and contribute to an inclusive, collaborative environment where great work can happen. Where You'll Be This role is based in London, UK or Stockholm, Sweden We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home. Compensation Additional Information

title: Learning Experience Designer
description: Role Description As a Learning Experience Designer within Dropbox ’s Customer Advocacy organization, you will create engaging, accessible, and effective learning experiences that help customers and administrators understand Dropbox products, complete key tasks, and achieve their goals. You will design and maintain customer education across Dropbox Learn, product-launch education, learning paths, multimedia tutorials, and other self-service learning experiences. Working closely with cross-functional partners, you will translate complex product capabilities and customer needs into clear, actionable instruction. You’ll combine instructional design principles, digital content production, and responsible AI-assisted workflows to develop scalable learning experiences. Your work will contribute to helping customers become more confident and successful with Dropbox products while improving the consistency, quality, and accessibility of customer education. Responsibilities Design, develop, publish, and maintain engaging, accessible, and accurate customer learning experiences across Dropbox products and education platforms. Create and update web-based training, learning paths, product-launch education, tutorials, multimedia content, and other instructional resources. Translate complex product workflows and customer needs into clear, task-oriented instruction with logical sequencing and actionable next steps. Author, publish, and maintain learning content using Contentful and related content-management and learning-delivery platforms, including quality assurance and localization preparation. Collaborate with Product, Product Marketing, Customer Advocacy, Support, subject-matter experts, and program managers to deliver education aligned with customer and business needs. Responsibly leverage AI tools to support content drafting, storyboarding, synthesis, analysis, and production efficiency while validating outputs for accuracy, accessibility, instructional quality, and customer relevance. Support continuous improvement of learning experiences through reusable templates, documented processes, customer feedback, performance insights, and content-quality standards. Requirements Experience creating or maintaining customer-facing learning, instructional, technical, enablement, or product education content. Ability to translate complex product concepts and workflows into clear, structured, task-oriented instruction. Experience using content-authoring, learning-management, or publishing platforms. Ability to collaborate effectively with subject-matter experts and cross-functional stakeholders to develop and refine instructional content. Understanding of instructional quality principles, including accuracy, accessibility, consistency, and learner usability. Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple content deliverables, incorporate feedback, and meet deadlines. Ability to learn and responsibly use AI-assisted tools to improve productivity while maintaining accountability for content quality and accuracy. Preferred Qualifications Experience developing web-based training, interactive learning, quick-start guides, video tutorials, or progressive learning paths. Familiarity with Contentful, Articulate, Wistia, or comparable content and learning-production tools. Experience supporting product launches, localization, or customer self-service education programs. Experience using learning analytics, customer feedback, or content-performance data to inform improvements. Experience collaborating with distributed teams in a technology or SaaS environment. Durable Skills AI fluency means using these tools to amplify human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technology continue to evolve: Awareness: Understand yourself and others. Judgment: Evaluate information and make decisions in complex situations. Adaptability: Learn, adjust, and stay effective through change. Connection: Communicate, collaborate, and build trust. To learn more about why these skills matter and what the data shows about thriving through change, read this blog post from our Chief People Officer, Melanie Rosenwasser. Compensation Ireland Pay Range €37.800—€51.200 EUR

title: Product Manager - Data Platform
description: Spotify ’s mission is to unlock the potential of human creativity by giving a million creative artists the opportunity to live off their art and billions of fans the chance to enjoy and be passionate about these creators. Data is a means to an end, and Spotify extracts value from data through application. The Data Platform Studio helps Spotify win by enabling the application of data in an intuitive and efficient way. Data Platform is responsible for how data is collected, processed, stored, governed, and made available to the thousands of engineers, data scientists, analysts, and machine learning practitioners who build Spotify’s products. As AI agents increasingly generate code, write data pipelines, and power personalized user experiences, Data Platform sits at the center of one of the most important infrastructure domains at Spotify. We're looking for a passionate Product Manager to join the team responsible for Spotify’s data catalogue, metadata, and data lineage capabilities. In this role, you'll own the strategy and roadmap for a critical part of Spotify's data ecosystem, helping users discover, understand, trust, and safely use data at scale. You'll work closely with engineers, designers, data scientists, and product teams across Spotify to make working with data faster, safer, and more intuitive. What You'll Do Develop and own the product strategy and roadmap for Spotify's data catalogue, metadata, and data lineage domain. Diagnose and deeply understand the needs of Spotify's data community, including data engineers, data scientists, analysts, ML engineers, and increasingly AI agents. Identify and prioritize the highest-impact problems to solve, balancing user needs, business priorities, platform requirements, and regulatory considerations. Evaluate and deliver solutions through building, buying, or integrating third-party products and capabilities. Define success metrics and KPIs that measure adoption, value creation, and business impact. Build strong relationships with internal product, engineering, analytics, and data teams to understand workflows, gather feedback, and shape future platform investments. Collaborate closely with engineering, design, and data science partners to deliver high-quality platform experiences. Influence stakeholders across the Data Platform Studio and broader Spotify organization to align around product direction and priorities. Help shape how Spotify approaches metadata, governance, discoverability, lineage, and trust in an increasingly AI-driven world. Stay informed on industry trends across data platforms, developer tools, AI/ML infrastructure, analytics, and data governance. Who You Are You have 2+ years of Product Management experience, ideally working on platform products, developer tools, data infrastructure, analytics platforms, or data governance systems. You have a technical foundation through a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, a related field, and/or prior experience in engineering or technical roles. You are comfortable working with engineers and can engage in technical discussions while representing customer and business needs. You are an excellent communicator and collaborator who can build alignment across teams with different priorities and levels of technical expertise. You have strong systems-thinking skills and can connect workflows, platforms, users, and business outcomes. You have empathy for people who work with data and understand the challenges they face every day. You enjoy working through ambiguity, breaking down complex problems, and creating clarity for teams. You are curious about how AI is transforming the data landscape and are excited to help shape that future. You lead with humility, build trust through collaboration, and help teams move forward with focus and momentum. Where You'll Be This role is based in London or Stockholm We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home. Compensation Additional Information

title: Intermediate Fullstack Engineer (Ruby/Vue.js), Growth
description: GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster. The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software. * Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab. An overview of this role As an Intermediate Fullstack Engineer (Ruby/Vue.js), Growth at GitLab, you'll help turn GitLab's self-serve funnel into a reliable source of new paying customers. You'll work on the in-product journey from a user's first visit through sign-up, trial, and first purchase, on both GitLab.com and self-managed GitLab. You'll collaborate closely with Product Managers, UX Designers, and Data Analysts, with a particular focus on backend development in Ruby on Rails and frontend work in Vue.js. This role gives you the opportunity to combine your fullstack engineering skills with product thinking and experimentation, shipping small changes quickly and measuring their impact on real customer outcomes. Some examples of our projects: Making it easier for self-managed users to try and buy GitLab Building upgrade prompts where users run into paid features Improving the trial experience, including trials of GitLab Duo Improving the tooling the team uses to run and read out experiments What you'll do Design, build, and iterate on A/B tests and experiments that increase first purchases on GitLab.com and self-managed GitLab. Build and improve registration, trial, onboarding, and in-product upgrade and purchase experiences to increase completion of these steps. Implement backend features and services in Ruby on Rails and frontend experiences using Vue.js. Analyze experiment results and product usage data with Data Analysts to decide which changes to keep, iterate on, or roll back based on first-purchase outcomes. Collaborate with Product Managers and UX Designers to define hypotheses and success metrics before shipping experiments, then compare results against those metrics. Maintain and improve our experimentation framework and tooling to increase experiment throughput and reduce the time from setup to results. Collaborate with other Engineering teams, including Fulfillment, to remove purchase barriers across GitLab’s codebase. Document decisions, review code, and share experiment results asynchronously so distributed teammates can track shipped changes and their measured outcomes. What you'll bring Professional experience developing with Ruby on Rails and modern JavaScript, along with solid Git, feature development, and deployment workflows. Experience working with relational databases and a solid understanding of web performance optimization. A track record of shipping features to production and owning them after release. Ability to use product data to decide what to build, keep, or roll back. Ability to document decisions and share updates asynchronously with distributed Product Management, UX, and Data teammates. Ability to organize your work, seek and apply feedback, and collaborate inclusively with teammates from diverse backgrounds, in line with GitLab’s values. Preferred, not required: experience with Vue.js, PostgreSQL, A/B testing, feature flags, experimentation frameworks, or SaaS sign-up, trial, billing, or checkout flows. We'll help you learn our tooling. About the team We’re GitLab’s Growth team: one team with one roadmap, prioritizing work by how directly it helps people buy. We work fully remotely and asynchronously across multiple regions, guided by GitLab’s values of transparency and iteration. Our challenge is running more high-impact experiments, faster, while coordinating changes with teams like Fulfillment and Pricing across the parts of the product they own. For more on how we work, see the Growth and Product sections of the GitLab handbook. title: Head of HR
description: WHO ARE WE? Launch Potato is the discovery and conversion company. We reach tens of millions of people every month through our brands, including FinanceBuzz , All About Cookies , and OnlyInYourState . We turn that attention into real outcomes for our partners, some of the world's leading companies. Our mission: create predictable, high-value customer acquisition at scale by connecting discovery, intent, and performance across category-leading consumer brands in finance, travel, and entertainment. We run profitable and bootstrapped, with a South Florida HQ and a remote-first team across 18 countries. WHY JOIN US? You own outcomes here, not tasks. We measure work by impact, not activity. The pace is real, and change is constant, so the people who do best turn change into opportunity instead of waiting for it to settle. Feedback runs direct and lands with respect. Ordinary people make themselves extraordinary at Launch Potato . Base salary: $170,000 to $190,000. Plus an annual bonus paid as a flat amount rather than a percentage of base. Launch Potato is about 200 people, profitable, and growing. The performance management system that got us here was built by our SVP of Talent, and he still runs it. That system becomes yours. You're inheriting something that works. There's a levels framework, a rating scale, a calibration process, and managers who have been through several cycles. It got us to 200 people. Your job is deciding what carries forward and change-managing the rest, across an org that moves fast and adopts new processes. We want someone who'll find the version that works and then hold it there while the company gets good at it. If you want to own a function, make it extraordinary, and be judged on whether it actually got better, keep reading. Why This Seat Real ownership, immediately. Performance, total rewards, and compliance are yours to own rather than support. You'll defend a compensation number in front of a CFO who checks it. An SVP who wants to hand this over. Not one who says that and then rewrites your deck. The explicit goal is that the HR function runs without him. Executive reach by default. Calibration and leveling decisions live with the C-suite, and you present your own work. You won't spend year one convincing anyone that performance management matters. Leverage is part of the mandate, not a side project. We are tech-first and AI-forward, which means we can run lean teams and do more with less. You'll push that further, build the tooling managers actually open, and make everything easier without taking substance out of it. Nobody will ask you to do it the slow way. How This Team Is Led From Kris Osborne, SVP of Talent . I'll tell you what I want and what the constraints are and then get out of the way. I don't rewrite people's work. If I disagree with where you landed you'll hear it from me early, and if you still think you're right then push back, because I'd rather change my mind than have you go quiet and build something you don't believe in. I ask before I decide. When something changes the shape of this team the people on it hear it from me first and they get a real say in it, not a heads up after it's done. I care about the outcome and I'm not going to do your job for you. Bring me a problem and I'll work it with you, but I'm not going to take it off your plate and hand it back finished. I'm hiring this seat because I want someone we can all learn from. Bring me a better answer than mine and I'll take it. What You'll Bring All required. A full performance cycle you owned end to end, not supported. Owned more than once, at 150 people or more. Design, timeline, manager prep, calibration, rollout, retro. Compensation and benefits you've owned. Band design, benchmarking methodology, benefits renewals, the annual comp cycle. You can defend a number to a CFO. HR compliance as standing scope, not as a project. Multi-state registration, I-9, handbook, classification, postings. You've inherited a backlog and cleared it. A people system that outlasted you. Built, adopted, and still recognizable two cycles later. Leverage you built that people adopted. You've automated or rebuilt part of a people process so it ran faster, the quality held or improved, and the team actually used it. Adoption is the test here, the same way durability is the test above. Experience taking a company our size to materially larger, on headcount or revenue, more than once. You know what breaks first at the next stage because you've watched it break. Empowered your team to raise the bar. You have clear examples of coaching, mentoring, and growing a team that created extraordinary outcomes. This is a player-coach seat. description: At ExtraHop , we’re on a mission to protect and empower the connected enterprise. With this insight, organizations can investigate smarter, stop threats faster, and keep operations running. Position Summary The Senior Accounting Manager is a key financial operations individual contributor role responsible for technical deferred commission accounting (ASC 340-40), global treasury administration, and international corporate governance across multiple foreign entities. Reporting to the Corporate Controller, this role serves as the subject matter expert for commission capitalization methodologies, global enterprise banking platforms, and foreign subsidiary statutory compliance. The ideal candidate combines technical accounting precision with strong operational execution to maintain internal controls, streamline global banking networks, and support scalable corporate expansion. Key Responsibilities Deferred Commissions Accounting ASC 340-30 Close Execution: Manage monthly close processes; including portfolio-based accounting, performance obligation allocations, weighted-average rate calculations, and monthly accrual, deferral and amortization entries. Rates Workbook & System Management: Prepare the Rates Workbook for bookings and commission reconciliations; maintain the deferred commissions dashboard and quarterly customer product life reports. Audit Readiness & Automation: Write annual technical audit memos, lead quarterly customer-life evaluations, and manage audit deliverables. Partner with the Commission's team on comp plan updates. Advance process automation using AI tools (e.g. Claude) and commission engine automation modules. Treasury & Global Banking Administration Global Bank Account & Portal Governance: Serve as System Administrator for enterprise global banking portals and enterprise accounts; manage user access, entitlements, and portal permissions while ensuring compliance with internal governance standards, periodic Know Your Customer (KYC) reviews, mutual TLS (mTLS) security protocols, ACH fraud filters, concentration sweep structures, and payment processing modules. Corporate Credit Card Administration: Administer the global credit card program, enforcing Merchant Category Code (MCC) policies, setting credit limits, investigating rejected authorizations, issuing cards, and serving as the primary accounting department cardholder. Banking Partner Relationships: Act as the primary corporate contact for commercial banking partners, leading recurring relationship meetings and leveraging bank support networks to optimize service levels and resolve escalations. International Subsidiary and Director Compliance International Subsidiary Governance & Annual Compliance: Ensure our nine international entities remain in good standing by holding Annual General Meetings (AGMs), filing required statutory documents on time, and managing ongoing corporate governance requirements across foreign jurisdictions. Entity Formation & Transitions: Partner with Legal and International Accounting to project-manage the legal and operational setup of new international subsidiaries; oversee the legal and administrative process for appointing, resigning, or undating foreign Directors. Banking Compliance & Execution: Maintain KYC documentation for periodic compliance reviews with foreign banks and regulatory bodies; lead weekly international operational syncs to track global filing deadlines and maintain cross-functional accountability. System Administration Financial Close Management Administration: Serve as System Administrator for financial close management software, managing user onboarding, workflow optimization, and continuous process support in coordination with the internal accounting team. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or Business Administration. 8+ years of progressive accounting experience in the tech industry (SaaS + Hardware), with direct expertise in ASC 340-40 (Cost of Obtaining Contracts with Customers) and ASC 606 (Revenue Recognition). 3+ years of experience managing global banking portals (specifically Citibank / CitiDirect / CitiManager) and corporate credit card programs. Proven background in international subsidiary management, board director changes, annual general meeting (AGM) filings, and global KYC/banking compliance. Preferred Qualifications Certified Public Accountant (CPA) or Certified Treasury Professional (CTP). Treasury background with a strong Accounting/Finance foundation. Corporate governance or international entity experience with a Paralegal or Law background. Skills and Competencies ERP & Financial Software: Advanced proficiency with ERP systems (e.g., NetSuite), financial close platforms (e.g. FloQast), and specialized commission engines (e.g. Xactly). Banking Portals: Expert-level familiarity with Citibank portals (CitiDirect, CitiManager) and electronic file transfer/security protocols (mTLS, ACH filters). Collaboration and teamwork: Works closely with recruiters, HRBPs, and leadership to support HR initiatives and work cooperatively with others within the organization and other cross-functional stakeholders. Resilience: Performs exceptionally well in fast-paced, high-stress environments. Reliability: Demonstrates predictable, reliable attendance and active engagement across all global responsibilities. We turn that attention into real outcomes for our partners, some of the world's leading companies. We run profitable and bootstrapped, with a South Florida HQ and a remote-first team across 18 countries. WHY JOIN US? You own outcomes here, not tasks. We measure work by impact, not activity. title: Senior Product Designer (Fully Remote)
description: The Role We Need: PadSplit is hiring a Senior Product Designer to shape and improve experiences across our two-sided housing marketplace. Working on a growth-focused product team, you’ll tackle meaningful, complex problems for members and hosts, helping make it easier to find, access, and provide affordable housing. You’ll play a central role in designing intuitive, human, and scalable experiences that create measurable impact for our customers and business. The Person We Are Looking For: We’re looking for a senior-level designer who blends strong product intuition, systems thinking, deep empathy for users, and growth-minded experimentation. You thrive in complex problem spaces, move fluidly between big-picture strategy and pixel-level detail, and can clearly connect design decisions to customer needs and business outcomes. Above all, you are authentic, collaborative, and energized by solving meaningful problems with cross-functional teams. Here’s What You’ll Be Doing Day-to-Day: Own End-to-End Product Design – Lead design from early problem definition and exploration through prototyping, launch, and iteration across PadSplit’s marketplace. Simplify Complex Experiences – Turn complicated workflows, rules, and marketplace dynamics into experiences that feel clear, intuitive, and approachable. Conduct User Research – Interview, observe, and gather insights from members and hosts to deeply understand their needs and translate them into stronger products. Drive Product Strategy – Partner with PMs to identify opportunities, shape solutions, and connect customer needs with measurable business outcomes. Experiment & Iterate – Use data, customer feedback, prototypes, and experiments to test assumptions and continuously improve experiences. Collaborate Cross-Functionally – Work closely with PMs, engineers, marketers, operations, and data partners to develop and deliver cohesive solutions. Craft High-Quality UI – Build responsive, polished interfaces in Figma using thoughtful components, interaction patterns, and PadSplit’s design system. Build AI-Infused Experiences – Prototype and design intelligent workflows and AI-powered features alongside our engineering, ML, and AI teams. Here’s What You’ll Need to Be Successful: Proven Experience – 4+ years designing digital products, ideally with complex acquisition funnels or marketplace environments. Deep UX Skills – Strong research abilities and comfort engaging directly with users to uncover pain points and opportunities. Business Fluency – Ability to connect design decisions to metrics, revenue, and real estate economics like rent, ROI, and occupancy. Workflow Mastery – Experience designing multi-step processes, complex service environments, and edge-case-heavy workflows. UI Excellence – Expertise in Figma and interaction design across web and mobile, with strong systems thinking and component reuse. Data Orientation – Familiarity with A/B testing, experimentation frameworks, and interpreting both qual and quant insights. AI Capability – Demonstrated experience designing AI-powered features and leveraging modern AI tools in your design practice. Authentic Collaboration – A humble, kind, curious, and mission-driven approach that elevates the team and the user experience. The Interview Process: NO BOTS HERE: your resume will be reviewed by live humans from PeopleOps and the hiring manager. If we’re interested, the next step would be a video screen with a member of the PeopleOps team for about thirty (30) minutes. If warranted, the next steps would be a project review with the hiring manager (1) hour. If warranted, the next step would be a design case study with key Design stakeholders at PadSplit for one (1) hour. If warranted, the final step would be a design craft exercise with key stakeholders at PadSplit for one-and-a-half (1.5) hours. If warranted, then we move to offer! Compensation, Benefits, and Perks: Fully remote position - we swear! Competitive compensation package including an equity incentive plan and company-wide bonus opportunity National medical, dental, and vision healthcare plans Company provided life insurance policy Optional accidental insurances, FSA, and DCFSA benefits Unlimited paid-time (PTO) policy with eleven (11) company-observed holidays 401(k) plan Twelve (12) weeks of paid time off for both birth and non-birth parents The opportunity to do what you love at a company that is at the forefront of solving the affordable housing crisis Compensation Compensation is based on the role's scope, national market benchmarks, the person's expertise and experience, and the impact of their contributions to our business goals. Additional Information Please note: Although the job posting says it's in Atlanta, Georgia, this is a fully remote position. This is a result of our Applicant Tracking System requiring a location to post the role on LinkedIn. Notice to Applicants: PadSplit participates in E-Verify. All new employees are required to complete an I-9 form and be authorized to work in the United States. Employment is contingent upon successful completion of the E-Verify process. PadSplit is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

title: Host Account Manager
description: The Role We Need PadSplit is hiring a Host Account Manager to serve as the dedicated strategic partner and primary point of contact for a portfolio of PadSplit hosts. This is a newly created role at the heart of our Host Success model, designed to shift how we support all hosts from reactive problem-solving to proactive, relationship-driven account management. You will own the full host relationship from activation through long-term retention. But owning the relationship means more than managing check-ins and reviewing dashboards. It means being a trusted partner and the person your hosts call when something goes wrong, someone who knows the platform, the policies, and the fee structures well enough to provide clear answers on the spot. You will be measured on the outcomes that matter most: your response times, occupancy performance, host satisfaction, churn reduction, and portfolio retention. This role is critical to ensuring every host in your book of business has what they need to thrive on the platform, and that they feel it. The Person We Are Looking For We are looking for a relationship-first operator who leads with data, follows through with hustle, and knows the product, policies, and PadSplit member outcomes well enough to earn a host’s trust in the first conversation. You are proactive by nature, the kind of person who spots a problem in a dashboard before a host ever has to call about it. You are also comfortable in the reactive moments: a confused host on the phone about a payout deduction, a complex situation involving a member that requires judgment and empathy in equal measure, a policy question that does not have a clean answer. You handle those moments with the same professionalism you bring to your scheduled portfolio reviews. You understand that being a trusted partner requires genuine knowledge. You do not escalate everything, and you do not guess. You build the platform and policy fluency to be the person who actually resolves the issue, and you know when escalation is the right call. You believe in PadSplit’s mission and understand what it means to work in the affordable housing space, where the stakes for both hosts and members are real. Here’s What You’ll Do Day-to-Day ACCOUNT MANAGEMENT AND RELATIONSHIP OWNERSHIP Own and manage a dedicated portfolio of PadSplit hosts, serving as their primary named point of contact for support ticket escalation and resolution, policy adherence and understanding, and overall portfolio direction Provide the right information at the right time, becoming a partner and strategic advisor of PadSplit Build proactive, trust-based relationships that reduce churn and increase host lifetime value. Conduct regular performance check-ins, including structured reviews aligned to host goals and PadSplit benchmarks. Drive host accountability on key metrics including attainable occupancy, bookability flags, rejection rates, move-in ratings, and member retention. Partner with hosts on portfolio growth, including conversations about adding new properties and expanding their PadSplit footprint. Serve as the host’s internal advocate, surfacing feedback and trends to product, operations, and leadership. PLATFORM, POLICY, AND FINANCIAL FLUENCY Maintain deep working knowledge of PadSplit’s platform, fee structures, payout mechanics, and host-facing policies, with the ability to explain decisions clearly and confidently. Serve as a knowledgeable, trusted point of contact for hosts navigating financial questions, policy inquiries, and operational challenges. Apply PadSplit policies thoughtfully, explaining both the “what” and the “why” in a way that builds understanding and trust rather than resentment. Guide hosts on pricing strategy, occupancy optimization, listing quality, rejection rate management, and platform best practices using both data and platform knowledge. Monitor host and property performance using PadSplit’s data tools, identifying risks and opportunities before they become problems. NEW HOST ACTIVATION Lead an intro call for every new host in your portfolio, establishing the relationship and setting expectations from day one. Guide new hosts from the beginning, covering pricing, room standards, rejection rate drivers, and mission-critical success requirements. Prepare hosts for their first members: responsiveness standards, room readiness expectations, and move-in experience requirements. Educate new hosts on member outcome drivers including safety compliance, pricing discipline, and platform behaviors that directly improve member, host and company outcomes. ISSUE RESOLUTION AND ESCALATION Navigate complex, nuanced host situations that require investigation, sound judgment, and fair resolution. Escalate and coordinate resolution of issues that require cross-functional support, working with member support, trust and safety, payments, and legal teams where appropriate. Manage emotionally charged conversations with empathy, composure, and directness, holding firm on policy while maintaining the relationship. Document ticket details and resolutions accurately, maintaining clear records across all host interactions. Identify patterns in host concerns and flag systemic issues to inform process, policy, or product improvements. TEAM AND PROGRAM DEVELOPMENT Contribute to the development of scalable playbooks, talk tracks, macro responses, and best practices as this function matures. Participate in weekly team syncs to share what is working, surface friction points, and iterate on the program in real time. Here’s What You’ll Need to Be Successful Account Management or Customer Success Background: 3+ years of account management, customer success, or high-touch client relationship experience. Background in real estate, property management, hospitality, or a platform-based marketplace is strongly preferred. Platform and Policy Fluency: Ability and willingness to develop deep working knowledge of PadSplit’s product, fee structures, and policies, and to use that knowledge in live host conversations. Proactive Portfolio Management: Proven ability to manage a large book of relationships with a proactive, not reactive, approach. You spot the problem before the host calls. Data-Driven Communication: Comfortable using data to tell a story and drive a conversation. You can translate performance metrics into clear, actionable guidance a host can act on today. Critical Thinking and Sound Judgment: Ability to analyze incomplete or conflicting information, apply policies thoughtfully in nuanced scenarios, and arrive at fair, defensible decisions. Extended Azure Services: Azure Container Apps, App Service, Azure Functions, Azure Database for PostgreSQL/MySQL Flexible Server, Azure Managed Redis, Service Bus. Landing Zones & Architecture: Azure Landing Zones (CAF), Virtual WAN, ExpressRoute. Certifications: AZ-104, AZ-700, AZ-400, CKA, or HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate. title: Director of HR
description: WHO ARE WE? Launch Potato is the discovery and conversion company. We reach tens of millions of people every month through our brands, including FinanceBuzz , All About Cookies , and OnlyInYourState . We turn that attention into real outcomes for our partners, some of the world's leading companies. Our mission: create predictable, high-value customer acquisition at scale by connecting discovery, intent, and performance across category-leading consumer brands in finance, travel, and entertainment. We run profitable and bootstrapped, with a South Florida HQ and a remote-first team across 18 countries. WHY JOIN US? You own outcomes here, not tasks. We measure work by impact, not activity. The pace is real, and change is constant, so the people who do best turn change into opportunity instead of waiting for it to settle. Feedback runs direct and lands with respect. Ordinary people make themselves extraordinary at Launch Potato . Base salary: $170,000 to $190,000. Plus an annual bonus paid as a flat amount rather than a percentage of base. Launch Potato is about 200 people, profitable, and growing. The performance management system that got us here was built by our SVP of Talent, and he still runs it. That system becomes yours. You're inheriting something that works. There's a levels framework, a rating scale, a calibration process, and managers who have been through several cycles. It got us to 200 people. Your job is deciding what carries forward and change-managing the rest, across an org that moves fast and adopts new processes. We want someone who'll find the version that works and then hold it there while the company gets good at it. If you want to own a function, make it extraordinary, and be judged on whether it actually got better, keep reading. Why This Seat Real ownership, immediately. Performance, total rewards, and compliance are yours to own rather than support. You'll defend a compensation number in front of a CFO who checks it. An SVP who wants to hand this over. Not one who says that and then rewrites your deck. The explicit goal is that the HR function runs without him. Executive reach by default. Calibration and leveling decisions live with the C-suite, and you present your own work. You won't spend year one convincing anyone that performance management matters. Leverage is part of the mandate, not a side project. We are tech-first and AI-forward, which means we can run lean teams and do more with less. You'll push that further, build the tooling managers actually open, and make everything easier without taking substance out of it. Nobody will ask you to do it the slow way. How This Team Is Led From Kris Osborne, SVP of Talent . I'll tell you what I want and what the constraints are and then get out of the way. I don't rewrite people's work. If I disagree with where you landed you'll hear it from me early, and if you still think you're right then push back, because I'd rather change my mind than have you go quiet and build something you don't believe in. I ask before I decide. When something changes the shape of this team the people on it hear it from me first and they get a real say in it, not a heads up after it's done. I care about the outcome and I'm not going to do your job for you. Bring me a problem and I'll work it with you, but I'm not going to take it off your plate and hand it back finished. I'm hiring this seat because I want someone we can all learn from. Bring me a better answer than mine and I'll take it. What You'll Bring All required. A full performance cycle you owned end to end, not supported. Owned more than once, at 150 people or more. Design, timeline, manager prep, calibration, rollout, retro. Compensation and benefits you've owned. Band design, benchmarking methodology, benefits renewals, the annual comp cycle. You can defend a number to a CFO. HR compliance as standing scope, not as a project. Multi-state registration, I-9, handbook, classification, postings. You've inherited a backlog and cleared it. A people system that outlasted you. Built, adopted, and still recognizable two cycles later. Leverage you built that people adopted. You've automated or rebuilt part of a people process so it ran faster, the quality held or improved, and the team actually used it. Adoption is the test here, the same way durability is the test above. Experience taking a company our size to materially larger, on headcount or revenue, more than once. You know what breaks first at the next stage because you've watched it break. Empowered your team to raise the bar. You have clear examples of coaching, mentoring, and growing a team that created extraordinary outcomes. This is a player-coach seat. Managers here lead a team and deliver work personally, at every level. Nice to Have You have opinions about what performance management gets wrong, and specific examples of what you changed You can tell a process problem from a manager-capability problem, and you fix the right one You're the person who says the uncomfortable thing in a calibration room What You'll Own Performance management. The mid-year and annual cycles end to end: design, timeline, communication, execution. What the cycle needs to produce and what to cut. A timeline published early enough that managers plan around it. The retro after each one, and the judgment about when a change is warranted and when to leave it alone. Total rewards. Band design and the benchmarking methodology behind it. Benefits renewals and the economics underneath them. The annual comp cycle, with leveling and pay kept connected. Compliance. Multi-state registration, I-9, handbook, classification, postings. The current backlog, plus the escalation and coverage protocols that follow it. Manager enablement. Preparing managers for real performance conversations, including the one where someone rated themselves higher than their manager did. The calibration process, including where two managers apply the same bar differently. Playbooks and self-service resources so a manager gets an answer without booking a meeting. Standing support for the roughly three dozen front-line managers who get it reactively today. Leverage and tooling. Finding the parts of everything above that shouldn't be done by hand, and fixing them. Building what a manager will actually open rather than what looks good in a demo. Taking time out of the cycle while the conversations get better rather than thinner. The team. An HR Business Partner and a Total Rewards and People Analytics lead. Both are strong at what they do and both have room to grow. You set their decision rights: where they decide, where they recommend, where it comes to you. What Great Looks Like In your first year: The annual cycle ships on your timeline and you own it Managers are calibrated before the cycle rather than corrected after it Every person leaving a check-in has one clear thing to work on, and the conversation that produced it was a real one The compliance backlog is closed and stays closed The cycle costs managers less time than the year before, and the conversations are better rather than thinner Your two reports hold more decision authority than they did at the start This Isn't the Right Seat If This would be your first Director-level people role You lead with policy and risk. Compliance is required here and it isn't the center of the work You want to redesign the cycle every year You see tooling and automation as somebody else's job You're looking for a recruiting role. Recruiting sits elsewhere in the function Want to accelerate your career? Apply now! Since day one, we've been committed to having a diverse, inclusive team and culture. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

description: About Juniper Square Private markets are one of the largest, most complex, and most underserved corners of global finance. Our mission at Juniper Square is to unlock their full potential. We’re the Operations Partner trusted by 2,300+ GPs, unifying technology, data, and fund administration services into a single platform that helps GPs move faster, make better decisions, and scale with precision. With $300B+ under administration and 700,000+ LPs on platform, we’ve built the scale to match our ambition. And with JunieAI, our purpose-built AI platform, we’re reimagining how private markets operate, embedding intelligence across every workflow. Founder-led since 2014, backed by $350M+ in funding, and now 1,000+ employees strong, we’re building a company designed to shape the future of private markets for decades to come. Our culture is built for people who want to do ambitious, meaningful work alongside exceptionally talented teammates. We think like owners, move with urgency, and take pride in solving hard problems that truly matter to our customers and the future of private markets. We believe the best ideas come from open debate, deep collaboration, and diverse perspectives, which is why we believe transparency is the default and feedback makes us stronger. If you’re energized by high standards, rapid growth, and the opportunity to help define a category at a pivotal moment, come join us! Juniper Square offers employees a variety of ways to work, ranging from a fully remote experience to working full-time in one of our physical offices. We invest heavily in digital-first operations, allowing our teams to collaborate effectively across 27 U.S. states, 2 Canadian Provinces, India, Luxembourg, and England. We also have physical offices in San Francisco, New York City, Mumbai and Bangalore for employees who prefer to work in an office some or all of the time. About your role Fund administration is one of the most important and fastest-growing areas of the Juniper Square business, and how we win there depends on product marketing expertise that sits shoulder-to-shoulder with Sales. We're seeking a Senior Product Marketing Manager, Fund Administration to partner with leadership on GTM strategy, as well as own the messaging, positioning, and enablement that move fund administration deals forward. What sets this role apart: fund administration is a service, so understanding the offering means understanding the people who deliver it. You'll know our fund administration leaders and experts cold, including where each one is strongest, and you'll know our reference clients and how they differ across size, asset class, and profile. Keeping that picture current as the team scales fast is one of the most important parts of the job. This role reports to the Head of Product Marketing and partners closely with Sales leadership and Pipeline. What you'll do Fund Administration strategy, positioning & messaging Own Juniper Square's go-to-market strategy, positioning and messaging for the fund administration business unit, articulating a differentiated value proposition for each stakeholder in the buying group; CFOs, fund controllers, Heads of Finance and Fund Operations, leaders across investor services, accounting, treasury, compliance, and loan operations, and technical evaluators. Position Juniper Square's fund administration service so buyers understand not just what it delivers but how it changes the way their teams work, and prepare Sales and Customer Success to have credible, informed conversations about it. Build the fund administration persona and industry playbooks: buyer and influencer roles, priorities, objections, and content needs at every stage of the sales journey. Fund administration expertise & references Build and maintain a living map of Juniper Square's fund administration leaders and experts: who presents well, where each one is strongest, and who to bring into a given deal or moment. Keep that picture current through constant data-gathering as the fund administration team grows fast, so sales always knows who to pull in and when. Maintain deep knowledge of our fund administration reference clients and how they vary by customer size, asset class, and profile, so sellers can match the right proof to the right prospect. Fund administration launches Own every fund administration product and feature launch end to end with repeatable frameworks that scale from major product announcements to quarterly release moments. Define what launch readiness looks like and drive the cross-functional plan that gets there, so each release lands with Sales, Customer Success, and the market ready. Close the loop after launch, feeding adoption signal and customer feedback back to Product to shape what ships next. Sales enablement & deal support Work directly with Sales leadership and top sellers to co-create the collateral that wins fund administration deals: executive briefs, ROI narratives, competitive battlecards, demo narratives, and stakeholder-specific decks for each stage of the buying process. Drive pipeline, upsell, and cross-sell velocity across the GP experience and fund administration suite, maintaining a cohesive release narrative that keeps prospects and customers engaged across the lifecycle. Act as the internal expert on fund administration deal dynamics, playing an active role in shaping messaging and strategy on high-stakes opportunities. Voice of customer & competitive intelligence Conduct deep voice-of-customer research through customer interviews, win/loss analysis, and Sales feedback to continuously enrich our understanding of fund administration personas and use cases across investor services, accounting, treasury, compliance, and loan operations. Create the fund administration customer stories that validate our messaging with real-world proof. Own competitive intelligence for the fund administration segment and disseminate actionable insights to Sales, Growth Marketing, and Product so the whole go-to-market motion stays aligned around how these teams actually buy. Build AI-native Use AI agents and tooling as core infrastructure to research accounts, synthesize customer and competitive inputs, which measurably accelerates the production of messaging and enablement assets. Apply judgment to what AI produces: know where automation accelerates the work and where human insight matters. Qualifications 3+ years of experience in or adjacent to fund administration is required (at a fund administrator, on a fund CFO, controller, or finance operations team, or at a company selling fund administration technology or services); you understand how these teams operate, who the buyers are, and what they care about. Experience in B2B product marketing or GTM strategy roles is advantageous but not required, with a strong bias toward supporting Sales and influencing deal outcomes. AI Fluency: experience using LLMs, agents, and AI automation tools to measurably accelerate your work, and understanding where human judgment is critical. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; the ability to translate nuanced market insights into clear, compelling GTM artifacts. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of members across 195 countries – from pre-pregnancy through menopause and major life moments in between. Carrot's comprehensive clinical program delivers industry-leading cost savings for plan sponsors and award-winning experiences and improved outcomes for millions of people worldwide. Carrot is widely regarded as a defining force in healthcare innovation as a recipient of several top-tier awards, including Fast Company's 'Most Innovative Companies' and CNBC's '100 Barrier Breaking Startups'. Day to day, you will meet with members by video to talk through their fertility questions and goals, offering clear, practical information without diagnosing, prescribing, or directing care.. This is a chance to put your fertility experience to work in a fast-growing digital health environment, with the flexibility of a contract schedule. family-building pathways Conduct one-on-one virtual sessions (video) that educate and present options without diagnosing, prescribing, or directing care Stay current on reproductive and fertility regulatory trends and clinical practice guidelines in the US Participate in quality assurance initiatives and audits to help ensure a safe, compliant member experience that meets the highest standards range to meet member demand throughout the engagement What Success Looks Like In your first 30 Days, you will have: Delivered consistently high-quality, well-rated fertility sessions that help members feel informed and supported Stayed within Carrot’s non-diagnostic, non-directive scope of practice and met documentation and quality standards across member interactions Met your agreed weekly hours and availability, communicating proactively about scheduling and capacity Ramped up quickly and worked independently with minimal oversight in a confidential, remote environment Built trusted working relationships with the Medical Experts team and cross-functional partners About You ✨ You likely have: An active US license as a Registered Nurse (RN), Nurse Practitioner (NP), or Physician Assistant (PA) 3+ years of experience providing patient care in a fertility clinic or a hospital clinic that addresses reproductive health Superb listening skills and the ability to empathetically discuss fertility and family-building topics The ability to work independently and to distinguish good clinical judgment from non-directive guidance The ability to work from a confidential and private remote environment with reliable internet and digital resources Flexibility to adapt to evolving business needs and availability for 15 per week for a 3-month engagement Nice to Have ⭐ While not required, we would be especially excited if you bring: Experience in third-party reproduction (e.g., gestational surrogacy, donor gametes), urology, pregnancy, or menopause Experience in digital health or telehealth settings, including virtual member or patient education Prior contract or consulting experience with a quick ramp-up Fluency in an additional language Why This Role Matters Fertility journeys are deeply personal, and members often arrive with more questions than answers. As a Fertility Medical Expert, you will be the knowledgeable, compassionate clinical voice who helps them understand their options and feel prepared for the conversations they have with their own care teams. Your expertise helps make Carrot’s clinical program one that members trust and rely on, and it strengthens the confidence of the employers and health plans who count on Carrot to deliver high-quality, whole-person care. title: Sales Manager
description: Win new restaurants across Germany and help build one of our fastest-growing markets from the ground up. We build it as one connected data layer, replacing the fragmented stack most restaurants run today: a listings tool here, a separate storefront there, and no CRM at all. title: Manager, Fund Administation (Onboarding)
description: About Juniper Square Private markets are one of the largest, most complex, and most underserved corners of global finance. Our mission at Juniper Square is to unlock their full potential. We’re the Operations Partner trusted by 2,300+ GPs, unifying technology, data, and fund administration services into a single platform that helps GPs move faster, make better decisions, and scale with precision. With $300B+ under administration and 700,000+ LPs on platform, we’ve built the scale to match our ambition. And with JunieAI, our purpose-built AI platform, we’re reimagining how private markets operate, embedding intelligence across every workflow. Founder-led since 2014, backed by $350M+ in funding, and now 1,000+ employees strong, we’re building a company designed to shape the future of private markets for decades to come. Our culture is built for people who want to do ambitious, meaningful work alongside exceptionally talented teammates. We think like owners, move with urgency, and take pride in solving hard problems that truly matter to our customers and the future of private markets. We believe the best ideas come from open debate, deep collaboration, and diverse perspectives, which is why we believe transparency is the default and feedback makes us stronger. If you’re energized by high standards, rapid growth, and the opportunity to help define a category at a pivotal moment, come join us! Juniper Square offers employees a variety of ways to work, ranging from a fully remote experience to working full-time in one of our physical offices. We invest heavily in digital-first operations, allowing our teams to collaborate effectively across 27 U.S. states, 2 Canadian Provinces, India, Luxembourg, and England. We also have physical offices in San Francisco, New York City, Mumbai and Bangalore for employees who prefer to work in an office some or all of the time. About your role This is a great opportunity to join a growing initiative as we continue to evolve and scale Juniper Square’s fund administration service, filling a substantial market gap in the fund administration space. The service has had a huge impact across the business as it relates to workflow automation, leveraging technology to deliver up to par customer experience, and enabling GPs to strengthen relationships with LPs. As a Manager, Fund Administration (Onboarding), you will oversee the successful onboarding of new customers onto our services, focusing on fund accounting and reporting setup. This role will independently manage client relationships throughout their implementation. You will have a significant opportunity to help shape the trajectory of the onboarding function and in so doing help to deliver a best-in-class initial experience for our new customers. What you’ll do Lead and manage the successful onboarding of new fund administration customers, partnering closely with cross functional teams. Manage against established project plans and onboarding milestones to ensure timely execution of key deliverables. Interface directly with clients to deliver an outstanding client experience throughout the implementation process. Serve as a technical accounting expert for both your team and our clients during the onboarding phase. Lead efforts in improving onboarding workflows, applying best practices and process efficiencies. Oversee the collection and review of customer offering documents (LPAs, etc.) and financial data, reconciling the data received during the onboarding process. Reconcile customer data and review the final setup of the completed customer workspace, checking for quality and accuracy of configuration settings before handoff to the ongoing service teams. Identify product development opportunities, routing technical and product feedback from onboarding to the product development teams. Participate in special projects as needed. Qualifications 7+ years of fund accounting experience in private equity, venture capital, and/or real estate funds required. 3+ years of people management experience (hiring, building teams, performance management, coaching, career development) Proven experience with customer onboarding, data migration, or implementations in a fund administration or fin-tech environment. Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or a related field. Proven ability to independently identify, analyze, and resolve complex problems with minimal supervision. Comfortable with ambiguity within a hyper-growth, startup environment. Experience with fund-level accounting and reporting, including complex fund structures and consolidations. Advanced understanding of complex accounting transactions, private equity investment structures, and reporting requirements for private equity funds. Passion for technology and a desire to use technology to improve business operations. Experience scoping out system requirements and implementing new systems. At Juniper Square, we believe building a diverse workforce and an inclusive culture makes us a better company. If you think this job sounds like a fit, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all the qualifications. Compensation Compensation for this position includes a base salary, equity, and a variety of benefits. The U.S. base salary range for this role is $130,000-$140,000 USD. The Canadian base salary for this role is $140,000-150,000 CAD. Actual base salaries will be based on candidate-specific factors, including experience, skillset, and location, and local minimum pay requirements as applicable.
